messages: Your father is right to be worried about you. Yours is too reckless a spirit!
Had I the jurisdiction to say so, I'd keep you in this village until the war against Skycorps comes to an end.
Do be careful out there, girl. These forests, while sacred, are perilous!

suite.message: But this girl has wrought far too much headache for this tribe, Chief.
Ever since she was a child and began spelunking wantonly in the sacred burial grounds of our tribe, she has been of great concern to me.
She ought not leave this village again!
